title: NivKode 0.1.0 RC8 is a review candidate
text: NivKode 0.1.0 RC8 is a review candidate. Release approval and publication are pending. Linux x86_64 install evidence used a fake local provider; it does not establish live-provider acceptance. No Android physical-device acceptance is claimed. The launch target remains 2 November 2026 and may move if testing finds issues. We also corrected our own research records: some ratings we'd labelled as human were made by an AI model. Those results stay inconclusive, and we've tightened our rules so it can't happen again. Honest results matter more than good-looking ones.
